name: Sharda University Online

about.text: Sharda University was established in 1996 and today it is the largest educational group located in Uttar Pradesh. It offers various undergraduate postgraduate, diploma, and other certificate courses in online and regular modes. This institute consists of more than 13,000 students and more than 900 teachers and other faculty members.

The University has various campuses in Agra, Greater Noida, and Mathura. Its main campus is spread over 180 acres of land with a 3.5 million square feet infrastructure. The University is approved by the University Grants Commission, under the UGC Act 1956. It is a full-fledged University and not just a deemed University. Also, the University is approved by the State Legislature of Uttar Pradesh.

The University is vibrant and diverse and has students from 95+ countries 29 states and many other places. It has various national and international recognitions with 200+ functional MOUs under Tuition fee programs/ Semester Exchange to offer global exposure and boundless opportunities. It has also been accredited by the National Assessment & Accreditation Council (NAAC) with a grade of A+. It is awarded for excellent education by ASSOCHAM which is supported by the Ministry of Commerce, Government of India.

about.text: The University is approved by the NBA which is the National Board of Accreditation offered for engineering programs. It has collaborated with 210+ national and international organizations. Currently, it is offering 130+ programs at undergraduate and postgraduate levels through departments like Engineering and Technology, Basic Sciences and Research, Agricultural Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences, Allied Health Sciences, Design, Architecture and planning, Nursing Science and research, Media, Film and Entertainment, Law, Medical Sciences & Research, Dental Sciences, Pharmacy, and Education.

As per the National Institutional Ranking Framework, the University is ranked 87th in the University Category. In the Management category, it is ranked 101-125th rank, in engineering rank it is ranked 150-200 position, and in pharmacy, it is ranked 62nd. It is also approved by UGC, Department of Higher Education, a prestigious member of the Association of Indian Universities. Bar Council of India (BCI), National Medical Commission (NMC), Dental Council of India (DCI), Council of Architecture (COA), NCTE, INC, ASIC and many more. Online courses offered by the University are Bachelor of Business Administration (General), Bachelor of Computer Application (General), Bachelor of Arts (Hons. Political Science), and Master of Commerce (General).

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

admission.text: If you are planning to take admission to Sharda University, you can apply through online mode. The first step is selecting the study field and course. Also, make sure to checkmark all the eligibility criteria issued by the University. You can find the course from the list. Here are some steps that can be followed to get enrolled in the University.
Step 1- Find the right course as per the qualifications and the eligibility criteria.
Step 2- Now, make a new registration by filling in the required personal credentials.
Step 3- Two-step verification will be done and the Students will be eligible to fill the rest of the application form.
Step 4- The next step is uploading the documents and scanning them before submitting them on the portal.
Step 5- The final step is submitting the fee. Students should take the final print of the application form and fee receipt.
Step 6- After the verification of all the details the students will be updated regarding the confirmation of the admission.

Does Sharda University Online provide a refund? Refunds for Sharda University Online depend on when the cancellation is made, as per the UGC Refund policy. Cancellations 15 days or more before the admission closing date qualify for a 100% refund; within 15 days before qualify for 90%; within 15 days after qualify for 80%; and within 16–30 days after qualify for 50%. No refund applies after 30 days. Click here to read the full notice.

examination.text: The Examination will be conducted in online mode. The students get the login credentials to the iCloud portal. The students can access all the information on the portal through mobile phones or laptops. Students can get all the information related to the timetable, attendance, class content, and various other resources.

The examination pattern and marking will vary from subject to subject. Students have to work closely on studying and making notes at their convenience. Since the study material is available 24/7, they can access the same anytime anywhere. The Students must have a system with good internet connectivity.

Examination Pattern: Semester-based examination with a mix of internal assessment (assignments, quizzes, project work) and end-semester exams conducted through online proctored mode. Grading follows CBCS system.

placementText.text: The University is offering top job and career options to the University graduates. At Sharda, the placements drive runs for both summer and final jobs. The placement department is efficient and bridges the gap between graduates and big recruiters and companies. The main objective of the department is to sharpen the creative talents of the University by offering quality education to the students and also by improving the analytical skills of the students.

They are offering 100% placement to the students, with the support of 450+ recruiters, 30+ companies, and 150+ Multinational Companies that offer one crore packages to the students. At present, the top recruiters of the University are Sleepwell, Halonix, NTT Data, Amazon, Mahindra Rise, Videocon, iGate, Wipro, Compro Technology, Johnson Controls and many more.

faculty.name: Dr. Avinash Bhowate
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, MBA — Centre for Distance and Online Education
faculty.description: Dr. Avinash Bhowate specializes in marketing management, having more than 8 years of industrial and more than 8 years of academic experience. With an MBA and PhD in marketing management, he has contributed significantly to academia through numerous publications in national and international journals. His expertise extends beyond publication, reflecting his passion in his pursuit of advancing knowledge and nurturing future generations of scholars and learners.

faculty.name: Dr. Kirti Prashar
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, BBA — Centre for Distance and Online Education
faculty.description: Dr. Kirti Prashar specializes in commerce and marketing, possessing a wealth of knowledge backed by a Master's in Commerce, UGC NET certification, and a Ph.D. in Marketing; she brings academic excellence to her role. With more than five years of dedicated teaching and research experience, she has contributed significantly to academia through numerous publications, including books, book chapters, case studies, and research papers in esteemed national and international journals. Her expertise extends beyond publication, serving as an editor and reviewer for reputable academic journals and with a good number of patents published under her name. She epitomizes dedication, expertise, and passion in her pursuit of advancing knowledge and nurturing future generations of scholars and learners.

faculty.name: Dr. Sandeep Kumar
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, MBA — Centre for Distance and Online Education
faculty.description: Dr. Sandeep is working as an Assistant Professor at Sharda University, Greater Noida. He graduated in life science from MDU, Rohtak, Haryana, India. He secured his Master of Business Administration from TMV, Pune, Maharashtra, India, and his Ph.D. in marketing at MMU, Ambala, Haryana, India. He is in the field of management at Sharda University, Greater Noida, UP, India. He has been in the teaching profession for more than 9 years. He has presented 4 papers in national and international journals, conferences and symposiums. His main areas of interest include psychology, human behavior and brand management.

faculty.name: Dr. Shubh Arora
faculty.title: Associate Professor, MBA — Centre for Distance and Online Education
faculty.description: Dr. Shubh Arora is working as Associate Professor at Centre for Distance and Online Education, Sharda University. She has over 16 years of rich academic and research experience. Holding a Ph.D. in Marketing and an MBA in Marketing & Finance, she began her journey in academia after graduating from HNB Garhwal University. Driven by a passion for continuous improvement, she has undertaken a Refresher Course on Quality Research & Teaching Methodology from UGC-HRDC, Jodhpur. She is committed to fostering dynamic learning environments and employs innovative teaching pedagogy and strategies to enhance student engagement and comprehension. She cultivates an environment where students thrive and excel by integrating cutting-edge methodologies tailored to individual learning styles. Her expertise is evident in her extensive publication record, comprising over 10 papers in prestigious national and international journals indexed with SCOPUS, ABDC, UGC, and other databases. Her research interests span across services marketing, consumer behavior, retail management, digital marketing, and marketing management.

faculty.name: Dr. Tanya Rastogi
faculty.title: Assistant Professor, M.Com — Centre for Distance and Online Education
faculty.description: Dr. Tanya Rastogi is an academic and researcher having teaching experience of more than 6 years. With a Ph.D. from Amity University, Noida, focusing on the influence of sustainable marketing practices on customer loyalty and purchase intention, she also holds a Master of Commerce and a Bachelor's degree from Delhi University. She has accumulated significant teaching experience as a faculty at the University of Delhi and Amity University. She has numerous papers to her name published in prestigious journals, including those indexed by SCOPUS, Web of Science, and ABDC. She is a keen researcher with her research featured in "A category" journals such as the Journal of Cleaner Production. She has also presented papers in national and international conferences and attended many national and international seminars and workshops. Her research interests include sustainability, marketing, consumer behaviour, and brand loyalty.
